scores.rationale: Part tole grapevine chandelier, probably modern Florentine-style reproduction, plus tray and planters of little value.
Mixed decorative prints and unattributed works; signatures illegible, Rockwell and poster prints are low value.
Two Rand McNally Lee star charts, common mid-century printed items, modest collector demand.
Used HEMA/re-enactment armour, gambeson and Red Dragon mask; niche market, realistic total around $100-200.
Used, untested Stiebel Eltron wall heater needing hard wiring; secondhand value perhaps $40-80.
S. Hague hand linker has a specialist market, but untested and bulky; plus yarn, realistic $100-250.
Eminar head has some player/collector interest, working per catalogue; with small Gorilla amp about $100-200.
Boxed Frog Buccaneer and tinplate add some value, but rest is played-with diecast; about $50-90.
Australian Bebarfald bureau sewing cabinet, worn decals and finish, bulky; likely $50-120.
